Container.Name: fallout2-supercoop
Container.Overview: Fallout 2 co-op dedicated server with the Restoration Project. Mount a copy of your installed "Fallout 2 SuperCoop" folder (made by the Windows installer) at /game; saves are written into it. On start it continues the newest save, or begins a new game. Players join with the same SuperCoop release over a VPN (ZeroTier/Tailscale); never forward the port to the internet.

Config.Name: Game port
Config.Description: Players join this port. The Windows join launcher assumes 9300.

Config.Name: Game folder
Config.Description: A copy of your installed 'Fallout 2 SuperCoop' folder (master.dat, critter.dat, mods, data...). Must be writable by nobody:users (99:100).

Config.Name: Server name
Config.Description: Shown to players when they connect.

Config.Name: World
Config.Description: newest = continue the most recent save (or start a new game when there is none). A number 1-16 loads that slot.

Config.Name: Engine debug log
Config.Description: 1 writes f2_server-debug.log into the game folder (for troubleshooting).
